name: Potter & Moore Plc
summary: Potter & Moore Plc, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and markets personal care, beauty care, and fragrance products in the United Kingdom and internationally. The company offers haircare products, including shampoos, conditioners, styling, masks, serums, curl-dedicated, and treatments; skincare products, such as moisturizers, toners, cleansing/exfoliation, serums, masks, and balms, as well as skincare treatments and SPF skincare; and bath and body products, including moisturizers and lotions, hand care, footcare, baby care, and self-tan and spa-based products. It also provides grooming products and fragrances. The company offers its products under the Emma Hardie, Feather & Down, The Curl Company, Balance Active, T-Zone, Janina, and Creightons brands. It sells its products through retail and digital outlets, department stores, supermarkets, and drug stores. The company operates in Denmark, Vietnam, Saudi Arabia, Chile, the United States, Ireland, Australia, France, the United Arab Emirates, Nigeria, Germany, China, Georgia, Pakistan, Oman, South Africa, New Zealand, Latvia, and Ecuador markets. The company was formerly known as Creightons Plc and changed its name to Potter & Moore Plc in April 2026. Potter & Moore Plc was founded in 1953 and is based in Peterborough, the United Kingdom.
